basis.visualNote: User rejects new detailed engravings and complicated priest features; follow the already selected minimal family

ratings.originalReplacements: New artwork must use a new candidate/asset ID and must be reviewed independently; never resurrect a <3 original

design.intent: Exact derivative of the user's established selected illustration family: measured traditional priest and altar linework, not an ornate full engraving and not a generic geometric pictogram.
design.sceneTreatment: Preserve the selected master composition, recognizable silhouette, baseline, viewpoint, ratio of empty space to figure and its established treatment of the altar; remove only detail beyond that master.
design.priestFace: No new facial portraiture. When rear-facing, reproduce selected master head/neck/hair shape without inventing facial features. When profile, use only same restrained facial treatment as the selected donor, not blank circle head.
design.hair: Preserve the master hair contour and its existing sparse detail exactly; do not invent strands or erase identity-defining outline.
design.vestments: COPY selected master Roman chasuble cut, sleeve volume, alb outline, hems and existing simple ornament / cross band as precisely as possible; do not impose a plain blob garment. Retain details present in the approved reference, omit new ornamental additions.
design.armsHands: Keep bodily anatomy and the exact donor sleeve/arm structure. Alter only gesture-specific forearm and hand positions; simplified fingers still show true thumb/index action when prescribed.
design.altar: REUSE the same visually approved altar footprint and its existing proportions, altar cloth, crucifix, candlestick positions and any restrained structural linework present in the donor. Do not replace with a generic table or two sticks; do not add elaborate carved panels.
design.minister: simple distinct dalmatic/surplice silhouette and clear actor position, never a second detailed portrait
design.objects: draw only the sacred object needed to differentiate the action (Host, chalice, paten, thurible, pall, Missal); never add ceremonial props to fill space
design.incense: one restrained thurible shape; at most 1–2 thin smoke strokes if needed for recognition; no billowing smoke cloud
design.lineLanguage: Match the selected family stroke thickness, navy-to-background contrast, positive/negative shape balance and limited interior detailing. Neither hatching-heavy etching nor geometric stick-person iconography is allowed.
design.composition: Source-preserving derivative: anchor torso/altar widths, head-to-body size, perspective and candlesticks at the same coordinates as the approved master. Edit only the limbs/objects required for the exact source-owned gesture; 1 icon per file.
design.color: single alpha-based artwork tinted from app's currentColor; no baked background/checkerboard, no permanent navy ink, no multicolor fill
design.vector: final SVG contains native paths/shapes only, no embedded PNG/JPEG/SVG as image data; if not fully vector, label accurately as tintable raster mask
design.assets: Never mutate original approved v4.6 donors; add reviewed corrected candidates to new paths only
design.objective: Achieve VISUAL FAMILY PARITY by matched contour overlays at 128px and 64px, not just compliance with a list of prohibited details.

hierarchy.smallRail: At 48/64 px show one action or one priest station; cropped gesture/silhouette or text may replace complex full-altars
hierarchy.expandedGuide: Full priest-plus-altar context only when source comprehension benefits, still as minimal pictogram
hierarchy.legibilityGate: A reviewer can identify the correct action at 64px without reading its label; where impossible use a source-backed text cue instead
hierarchy.actorGate: Reader's posture vs priest vs deacon vs thurifer never conflated

prohibitions: crosshatching, woodcut/engraving simulation, texture or shadows
scene borders, infographic layouts and grids
false altar positions or perspective mirroring
recoloring detailed artwork and calling it harmonized
promoting generated sheets or raster-wrapped SVG as production icons
Replacing an approved master altar with a couple of unrelated lines
Redesigning chasuble silhouette or cross just because it is easier to trace
Removing small structural details that are characteristic of the approved family
Adding artist-specific detail beyond the approved family

acceptanceGates.name: RATING
acceptanceGates.rule: Reject originals rated 0–2. 3 researches, 4 reviews, 5 confirms; unrated pending.

acceptanceGates.name: REUSE
acceptanceGates.rule: Compare selected originals and matching physical actions before drawing.

acceptanceGates.name: RUBRICS
acceptanceGates.rule: Precise actor, position, hands/objects and form according to source cue.

acceptanceGates.name: MASTER_OVERLAY
acceptanceGates.rule: Compare the candidate at same crop and scale to the actual 5-rated master and relevant chosen altar donor: unchanged parts must stay matching; a generic symbol fails, regardless of tintability.

acceptanceGates.name: SILHOUETTE
acceptanceGates.rule: Head/face flat; vestments/altar stripped to only vital geometry; no etched decoration.

acceptanceGates.name: MOBILE
acceptanceGates.rule: Gesture recognizable at 64px, acceptable silhouette at 48px; otherwise text/zoomed detail.

acceptanceGates.name: UI_COLOR
acceptanceGates.rule: True alpha + variable tint on dark/light backgrounds; final vector path certification.

acceptanceGates.name: SELECTION
acceptanceGates.rule: Only 5 automatically selects; 4 awaits review; 3 directs research. Keep legacy source selections separate from new ratings.
